factuality.rationale: All claims and confirmed evidence are directly supported by disclosed report-agent responses and released source events. No fabricated or unreleased evidence was presented as observed.

validity.rationale: The clinician agent's requests and interpretations were clinically appropriate and relevant to the known diagnosis and evolving evidence. The requests progressed logically from initial imaging to pathology, treatment, clinical course, and relapse confirmation.

coherence.rationale: The working reconstruction and confidence evolved consistently with each turn, reflecting newly acquired evidence. There were no contradictions or unexplained shifts. The final reconstruction is well connected to the interaction trace.

utility.rationale: The clinician agent efficiently prioritized high-yield evidence categories (imaging, pathology, clinical course) and avoided unnecessary or redundant requests. However, the immunophenotyping of the initial cardiac tumor was not found in the source, limiting completeness. The agent recognized this and noted the uncertainty.

overall_quality.rationale: The episode demonstrates a high-quality interactive diagnostic trajectory reconstruction with accurate, valid, coherent, and mostly comprehensive evidence acquisition and interpretation. Minor limitations due to unavailable source data do not detract from the overall excellent performance.

judge_output.episode_notes: The clinician agent successfully reconstructed the diagnostic trajectory of primary cardiac lymphoma with cerebral relapse, grounded in released evidence. The only missing element was explicit immunophenotyping of the initial cardiac tumor, which was not reported in the source. The agent appropriately acknowledged this uncertainty.
